game.title: Los Angeles Chargers at Buffalo Bills

lede: Buffalo Bills carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#1 in EPA per play), while Los Angeles Chargers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#4 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Buffalo Bills -10.3 with a fair total of 45.9, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Chargers pass offence vs Buffalo Bills pass defence, which sits −0.178 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Los Angeles Chargers and Buffalo Bills have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
